name: print-social-b2b-ad-cards-with-flowchart-and-yellow-pills
title: Blue and yellow B2B ad carousel with flowchart diagrams, floating pills and white cards
whatItIs: A blue-and-yellow presentation of square ads: a mock social post beside a large light-blue card with bold headline 'competitive advantage', and five white cards each with a small tag pill, a bold-keyword headline and a diagram (node flowchart, impact map, prompt box, alert) with a yellow CTA pill and a black results card '10x 7x'.
whatItMeans: Clear and helpful; diagrams show the product rather than tell.
techniques: Show product diagrams inside ad cards.
Use tag pills to label each step.
End with a dark stat card.

vocabulary.definition: An ad card built around a product diagram.
A small label naming a step.
A dark card with big numbers.
A pill inviting the viewer to swipe.
